capabilities: Track initiative order as a plain-text code block
Read HP, AC and initiative from statblocks
Write damage, conditions and death saves back to character sheets
Run groups of identical creatures with a shared HP pool
Mirror the fight onto an Atlas VTT map and a player screen
disambiguation: Not a dice roller; it tracks turn order, HP and conditions for a fight, though it can roll initiative through a dice hook.
extras: Unofficial fan project; no game text or art ships with it. Companion plugins are optional — without them HP and AC are typed into the block by hand. Exposes an API (ri.*) and events so other plugins can drive the tracker.
intentEvidence: Roll for Initiative is built on Quick Initiative by walkertbrown (Bananafest Destiny).
motivation: Built as a separate plugin on Quick Initiative's plain-text format to add live character sheets, encounter cards, game systems and VTT sync.
problem: Running combat in Obsidian means juggling statblocks, character sheets and turn order by hand, with nothing keeping HP and conditions in step.
